lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots organized in a structured grid posterior to the branchial region, specifically forming four distinct horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows to form a coordinate-like matrix of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal ridge is visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side and shadowing on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The posterior margin of the prominent pectoral fin displays a ragged, irregular profile; a faint horizontal linear marking is observable in the mid-lateral region posterior to the gills.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal remoras (Echeneidae) clustered near the ventral surface and the base of the pectoral fin.
